comparison.objective: Seat a coolant hose on a barb and tighten its worm-drive clamp.
comparison.physical_skill: Axial hose insertion, nut-driver seating, repeated regrasping and 3 N·m tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Hose fully home; clamp behind bead and tight; tool and hands released.
comparison.reason: Shares seated rotary-tool use and bounded tightening, but not unlocking a retained adjustment collar, tuning damping from repeated impacts, or validating travel/rebound and lock drift.
